items.title: Charles Calello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 21, 2025
items.q: The transcript identifies Monk Rowe as the interviewer ('My name is Monk Rowe... I’m with Charles Calello today'). There is no mention of any prior personal or professional relationship between Charles Calello and Monk Rowe outside of this interview session.

ctx.x: Charlie was interviewed on July 21, 2025 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive and I’m with Charles Calello today which is a real thrill because you actually did what I wanted to do for a living. I just think that being an arranger is such a creative thing to do, and every week, every day you’re presented with a different issue. Would you agree with that statement?

Yeah well I started to do this as a hobby. I went to the Music & Arts High School and there was really talented, talented players at the age of 13 to 16 years old they were playing on a professional level. And the accordion player in the band, now we’re going back to the ‘50s so the accordion was a common instrument. I was an accordion player.
